create.name: Insight San Diego
create.bio:
Insight San Diego is a lay Buddhist community in southern California practising in the vipassana, or insight meditation, tradition. It is a volunteer-run non-profit with a board of directors and a set of committees, and its groups are led by experienced lay practitioners rather than a resident teacher. Visiting dharma teachers from the wider insight network, including teachers trained at Spirit Rock and the Insight Meditation Society, come to lead its retreats, daylongs, classes and talk series.

In person, the community gathers each Saturday morning at the First Unitarian Universalist Church in Hillcrest for meditation, a recorded or live dharma talk and shared reflection, with a second sitting group in Solana Beach in North County. Other groups include a weekly online lunchtime sit, several affinity groups, among them one for Black, Indigenous and people of colour, plus a book club and an ethics study circle. All teaching is offered on a donation basis. Its website also hosts a library of talks recorded at its own events and a step-by-step self-study guide for newcomers to the dharma.

courses.title: The Four Elements: A Path to Belonging (Daylong with Noriko Morita Harth)
courses.description: A Saturday of practice in Hillcrest built around the Buddha's contemplation of earth, water, fire and air. Sitting and walking meditation, gentle qigong and yoga, reflection and loving-kindness practice explore change and interconnection.

free_resources.title: Dharma Talk Library
free_resources.description: Recordings of talks given at the community's own events or by teachers connected with it, searchable by teacher, topic and date. Dozens of insight teachers are represented.

free_resources.title: Dharma Self-Study Guide
free_resources.description: An ordered route through recorded instructions and talks, starting with short sitting and walking guidance and moving on to the basic Buddhist frameworks of suffering, its causes and the path out of it.

free_resources.title: Weekly Online Meditation
free_resources.description: A 45-minute drop-in sit on Zoom every Tuesday lunchtime, with a short check-in, a guided meditation and time to share about practice. Beginners are welcome.

free_resources.title: Sitting Group – Central San Diego
free_resources.description: The community's Saturday morning gathering in Hillcrest: optional silent sitting, a check-in, a dharma talk from a senior insight teacher and mindful group sharing. Drop-ins are welcome.
